keep.text: Bas ek chhota sa change aur mera result ekdam badal gaya. Dekh rahe ho
kitna kam fat is time pe ho rakha hai. Main 26.9%
body fat tha mera 30 din pehle, aur aaj ke time pe mera body fat 15% hai. 30 din mein maine 11% body fat ghata diya hai.
Aur ye sirf aur sirf isi change ki wajah se hua hai. Aur ye change kya hai? Na diet hai sirf, na exercise hai sirf, supplement toh bilkul hi nahi hai.
Kis tareeke se aap log achhe tareeke se fast karte ho, ye sabse important hai. Aur ye saari cheezein

kaise shuru hoti hain, main batata hoon. Eating window aap logon ka chhota ho jaata hai pehle fasting mein, toh insulin gir jaati hai. Insulin gir jaati hai toh fat burning start ho jaati hai. Fat burning start ho jaati hai toh energy aati hai. Fat ki energy bahut zyada khatarnak hoti hai.
Jab energy aati hai toh exercise bahut zyada hone lagti hai. Exercise mein apne aapko push kar paate ho. Aap logon ki exercise achhi ho jaati hai toh body thakti hai,
aur neend achhi aati hai. Jab neend achhi aati hai, neend improve ho gayi
toh aapka stress girta hai. Stress girta hai toh cortisol level normal aata hai. Cortisol normal hua toh fat burn aur tezi se hota hai. Aur chautha domino, jab aap logon ko
Motivation aata hai toh consistency aati hai. Aur ye ek system hai. Ek cheez doosri cheez ko trigger karta hai. Ek achhi aadat doosri achhi aadat ko trigger karti hai.
Aur ye saari cheezein main bata raha hoon ek poore ke poore 2 ghante ke webinar mein.
webinar abhi join kijiye, milte hain webinar mein!
